description: Fill the current six-digit TOTP (SHA-1, 30-second step) into the focused main-page input in a supervised session without returning the code or seed. etld_plus_one identifies the saved credential site and must match the target page, including private suffixes. Requires agent control; frame targeting is refused.

etld_plus_one.description: The saved credential site, for example example.com or alice.github.io.

frame.description: Frame targeting is refused for OTP fills; use the focused input in the main page.

page_id.description: The page to act on, from list_pages or pages_opened. Defaults to the current page. Does not change the current page.

name: fill_otp
title: Fill saved OTP
